name: hintlint-public-mcp-pilot
description: Curated public MCP server scan pilot for source-available TypeScript, JavaScript, and Python servers.

methodology.scope: Top/high-signal source-available MCP server candidates selected from GitHub search results on 2026-07-30. This pilot excludes unsupported primary languages such as Go, C#, Rust, and Java until HintLint has language-specific extractors.
methodology.evidence_policy: Generated findings are unreviewed candidates. Public claims require manual review of every high-impact finding and exact commit pins.
